content.title: MSG Sports Could Finally Be a Winner. Buy the Stock.
content.summary: Sports teams have been winning investments, but shares of  Madison Square Garden Sports  the owner of the New York Knicks and Rangers, have languished.  In March, a group of investors agreed to pay $6.1 billion for the Boston Celtics, a record price for a National Basketball Association team, only to see that surpassed by the $10 billion fetched for the Los Angeles Lakers.  Blame the “Dolan discount,” a reference to CEO James Dolan and his family, who control the teams through supervoting shares.
